tooltip_definitions.Transaction Revenue: Fees earned from retail consumer and institutional trades across spot and crypto derivatives.
tooltip_definitions.Subscription & Services: Recurring and utility-based revenues including stablecoin interest sharing, blockchain staking rewards, and Coinbase One subscriptions.
tooltip_definitions.Stablecoin Revenue: Revenue earned via the Centre/Circle partnership from interest on reserves backing USDC held on and off platform.
tooltip_definitions.Adjusted EBITDA: Operating income adjusted for stock-based compensation, depreciation, amortization, and crypto asset impairment gains/losses.
tooltip_definitions.Trading Volume Market Share: Coinbase's share of global fiat-to-crypto and crypto-to-crypto trading volume across spot and derivatives.
tooltip_definitions.Total Operating Expenses: Consolidated expenses including transaction expenses, technology & development, sales & marketing, and general & administrative.
tooltip_definitions.Consumer Crypto Spot Volume: Direct trading volume executed by retail customers on the Coinbase consumer app and website.
tooltip_definitions.Institutional Volume: Prime brokerage, OTC, and high-frequency exchange execution volume for hedge funds, asset managers, and corporate treasuries.
tooltip_definitions.Derivatives Trading Volume: Regulated futures and perpetual contracts executed via Coinbase Financial Markets and INTX.
tooltip_definitions.Coinbase One: Paid consumer subscription tier offering zero trading fee allowances, boosted staking rewards, and priority support.
tooltip_definitions.True FCF: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditures, stock-based compensation, and finance lease obligations.
tooltip_definitions.Crypto Asset Volatility: Measure of price fluctuations across Bitcoin, Ethereum, and large-cap altcoins driving retail trading fee velocity.
tooltip_definitions.Base L2: Coinbase's Ethereum Layer-2 rollup network generating sequencer revenue and ecosystem developer activity.
tooltip_definitions.Deribit / INTX Integration: Integration of offshore derivatives venue Deribit with Coinbase International Exchange to expand global options OI.
tooltip_definitions.Stock-Based Compensation: Non-cash equity incentives granted to engineering, product, and leadership teams.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Flow: Cash generated by core brokerage operations, customer balance sweeps, and staking distributions.
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Diluted EPS: Net profit divided by diluted common shares, reflecting crypto mark-to-market accounting adjustments under ASU 2023-08.
tooltip_definitions.Net Income: Consolidated GAAP earnings attributable to common stockholders after tax and fair value crypto asset adjustments.
tooltip_definitions.Transaction Expenses: Miner fees, bank payment processing charges, and liquidity provider rebates incurred to settle trades.
tooltip_definitions.Cash & Cash Equivalents: Available cash, USDC balances, and short-term Treasuries held directly by Coinbase corporate treasury.
